_note: Made-up ideas showing the expected level for Nothing (cached with the rubric). Varied styles, including non-native English. Provisional until the gold set (R13) exists.

examples.idea: A founder proposes a WhatsApp credit ledger for neighbourhood shops; the founder states 50 shops use it daily.

assessment.title: Shops may not keep using it after the first month

cheapest_test.text: Count how many of the 50 shops logged a sale in each of the last four weeks.

assessment.resolution_criteria: At least 30 of 50 shops active in week four.

examples.idea: A founder proposes late night food delivery inside hostel; founder states warden is ok with vendor at gate after 10pm.

assessment.title: Wardens may not allow a vendor at the gate at night

cheapest_test.text: Ask two wardens in writing this week, before cooking anything.

assessment.resolution_criteria: Written permission from at least one hostel.

examples.idea: A founder proposes an offline crop-disease model under 20 MB; a verified repo shows the model running on a phone.

assessment.title: Accuracy in real fields is unknown

cheapest_test.text: Run it on 100 photos from one farm and compare with an agronomist's labels.

assessment.resolution_criteria: Agreement with the agronomist on at least 85 of 100 photos.
